subject: Renewal + capacity add: billing & PO coordination for AstraNova
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>

Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity add: next steps for billing & PO

Hi Sarah — great to chat this morning. Thanks for committing to the 2x capacity top-up for Q3 as part of the renewal. To keep the finance flow moving I wanted to confirm a couple of billing items so procurement can pick this up: 

- Can procurement issue a PO referencing Redwood deal ID DEAL-3812 (helps our AP match)
- Preferred remit-to and invoice email (we typically send PDF invoice + e-invoice to billing@company)
- Are you able to accept Net45 on this renewal/upsell? (we can accommodate)
- Finance will ask for vendor legal name, remit address and a current W-9 or equivalent tax form

I attached our invoice template to make procurement's life easier (see stub: Redwood_invoice_template.pdf). Proposed timeline: if we have a PO by end of week we can finalize the invoice and complete provisioning by next Tuesday. 

Next steps: procurement sends PO + billing contact, we produce draft invoice and Rafael will confirm the final remit details. Monica, can you please lock the order form once we have the PO?

Thanks — Jordan

---
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add: next steps for billing & PO

Jordan — thanks, this looks good. Quick answers from procurement side: 

- Procurement will issue PO within 48 hours; they asked us to confirm exact invoice line items and totals so the PO matches the invoice.
- Finance requires vendor legal name: please confirm full legal name and EIN for Redwood.
- Remit-to: our default is AP via billing@astranova.com (cc finance team at cfo@astranova.com)
- Net terms: our preferred is Net45 — confirm if Redwood can accept that for this renewal + top-up.
- They also asked for a completed W-9 (or foreign equivalent) and the invoice in PDF.

I'll loop procurement on this thread so they can request the formal docs if needed. Procurement: when you issue the PO please include the PO number and attach it here.

Thanks — Sarah
